title: Cloud Storage objects
summary: Cloud Storage keeps objects in buckets. An object name identifies the object within its bucket.
introduction: Cloud Storage keeps objects in buckets. An object name identifies the object within its bucket. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Cloud Storage keeps objects in buckets. An object name identifies the object within its bucket.

blocks.code:
Bucket: fictional-club-files
Object name: images/logo.png
Data: the logo file
blocks.title: Cloud Storage objects

blocks.text: The bucket groups objects. A slash in the object name is useful organisation, not a requirement for a real folder.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Choose an object name for a stylesheet.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Decide access rules deliberately before making any object public.
